prompt:
Here is a long configuration file. Answer the question at the end.

---
[database]
host = db.internal
port = 5432
name = production_db
max_connections = 100
ssl = true

[cache]
backend = redis
host = cache.internal
port = 6379
ttl = 3600
max_memory = 2gb

[api]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
workers = 4
timeout = 30
rate_limit = 1000

[auth]
method = jwt
secret_key = PLACEHOLDER
token_expiry = 86400
refresh_expiry = 604800

[logging]
level = info
format = json
file = /var/log/app/app.log
max_size = 100mb
rotate = daily

[storage]
backend = s3
bucket = myapp-assets-prod
region = ap-southeast-2
cdn_url = https://cdn.example.com

[features]
dark_mode = true
beta_features = false
maintenance_mode = false
max_upload_size = 50mb

[smtp]
host = smtp.sendgrid.net
port = 587
username = apikey
from_address = noreply@example.com
from_name = MyApp

[monitoring]
metrics_port = 9090
health_check_path = /health
trace_sample_rate = 0.1
error_alert_email = ops@example.com

---

What region is the S3 storage bucket configured for?
